cohort: The study included 130 Vietnamese women with stage II-IV pelvic organ prolapse.
finding: Vaginal pessary use was found to be safe, highly effective, and well tolerated, leading to significant improvements in symptoms and quality of life among women with advanced pelvic organ prolapse.
mod_finding: No significant relationships were found between pelvic organ prolapse stage and obstetric factors such as vaginal delivery or episiotomy.
